zh: 天德二年行尚書省以其印小，遂命擬尚書省印小一等改鑄。
literal: In the second year of Tiande, because the Branch Secretariat seal was too small, an order was issued to model it one degree smaller than the Secretariat seal and recast it.
idiomatic: In the second year of Tiande (1150), because the Branch Secretariat seal was too small, it was ordered recast one degree smaller than the standard Secretariat seal.

zh: 大定二十四年二月，鑄行尚書省、御史台、並左右三部印，以從幸上京。
literal: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year of Dading, seals were cast for the Branch Secretariat, the Censorate, and the left and right ministries of the Three Departments, to accompany the imperial visit to Shangjing.
idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-fourth year of Dading (1184), seals were cast for the Branch Secretariat, the Censorate, and the left and right ministries of the Three Departments for use on the imperial visit to Shangjing.

zh: 泰和元年八月，安國軍節度使高有鄰言：「本州所掌印三：曰'安國軍節度使之印'；
literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Taihe, Military Governor of the Anguo Army Gao Youlin said: "This prefecture holds three seals: one, the 'Seal of the Military Governor of the Anguo Army';
idiomatic: In the eighth month of the first year of Taihe (1201), Military Governor of the Anguo Army Gao Youlin said, "This prefecture holds three seals: the 'Seal of the Military Governor of the Anguo Army';

zh: 曰'邢州觀察使印'，吏、戶、禮案用之；
literal: one, the 'Seal of the Xingzhou Observation Commissioner,' used by the personnel, household, and ritual sections;
idiomatic: the 'Seal of the Xingzhou Observation Commissioner,' used by the personnel, household, and ritual sections;

zh: 曰'邢州之印'，兵、刑、工案用之。
literal: and one, the 'Seal of Xingzhou,' used by the military, penal, and works sections.
idiomatic: and the 'Seal of Xingzhou,' used by the military, penal, and works sections.

literal: Because name and reality do not accord, I request recasting."
idiomatic: Because names and functions do not match, I request that they be recast."

zh: 宰臣奏謂：「節度使專行之事自當用節度使印，觀察使亦如之，其六曹提點所軍兵民訟，則當用本州印，著為定制。」
literal: The chief ministers memorialized, saying: "Matters that the military governor alone may execute should naturally use the military governor's seal; the observation commissioner is the same. For the six bureaus' oversight of military affairs, troops, and civil litigation, the prefectural seal should be used — let this be established as a fixed regulation."
idiomatic: The chief ministers memorialized: "Matters reserved to the military governor should use the military governor's seal, and the same applies to the observation commissioner. For the six bureaus' oversight of troops and civil cases, the prefectural seal should be used — let this be established as a fixed regulation."

zh: 泰和八年閏四月，敕殿前都點檢司，依總管府例鑄印，以「金」、「木」、「水」、「火」、「土」五字為號，如本司差人則給之。
literal: In the intercalary fourth month of the eighth year of Taihe, an order was issued to the Directorate of Palace Front Inspection to cast seals according to the general commandery precedent, using the five characters "Metal," "Wood," "Water," "Fire," and "Earth" as designations; when this directorate dispatched personnel, seals were issued accordingly.
idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of the eighth year of Taihe (1208), the Directorate of Palace Front Inspection was ordered to cast seals following the general commandery precedent, using the five designations "Metal," "Wood," "Water," "Fire," and "Earth"; when the directorate dispatched officers, the appropriate seal was issued.
